Founded on 26 July 1989 and known as ''Almería Club de Fútbol'' until 2001, when it was renamed ''Unión Deportiva Almería''.{{cite web |url=http://www.udalmeriasad.com/udalmeria/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=55&Itemid=40 |title=Un club joven con un gran futuro |year=2007 |access-date=January 18, 2018 |work=UD Almeria SAD |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071016221448/http://www.udalmeriasad.com/udalmeria/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=55&Itemid=40 |archive-date=October 16, 2007 |language=es |url-status=dead }} The club currently plays in the {{Spanish football updater|Almería}}, and plays their home games at the 17,400-seat capacity [[UD Almería Stadium]].{{cite web |url=http://www.udalmeriasad.com/club//estadio-juegos-del-mediterraneo |title=Estadio Juegos del Mediterráneo |access-date=January 18, 2018 |work=UDA Almeria SAD |language=es |archive-date=January 19, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180119120427/http://www.udalmeriasad.com/club//estadio-juegos-del-mediterraneo |url-status=dead }}{{cite news |title=Estadio de los Juegos Mediterráneos |url=http://udalmeria.ideal.es/estadio/ |access-date=January 18, 2018 |newspaper=[[Ideal (newspaper)|Ideal]] |language=es |archive-date=January 26, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220126225756/https://udalmeria.ideal.es/estadio/ |url-status=dead }}"}}
